title: BLUEBERRY KOOL-AID // THE HOUSE OF THE UNDYING SNACK BAR
narrative: In a dark corner of the bazaar in Qarth, Pyat Pree mixes a pitcher of dark indigo beverage with a wooden spoon. 'Shade of the evening?' he scoffs, checking the paper carton. 'It's generic artificial Blueberry Kool-Aid powder mixed with tap water and corn syrup! We tell foreigners it opens the doors of perception so we can charge fifty silver honors a cup! That's why our lips turn blue—the food dye takes two weeks to wash off!'
resolvesPlotHole: Shade of the Evening is Just Artificial Dye
introducesPlotHole: Expired Artificial Blueberry Kool-Aid of the Undying

options.text: Offer a cup to Euron Greyjoy to fuel his oceanic blood rituals.
